ordered_diagnoses: Acute coronary syndrome due to thrombotic occlusion

candidates.name: Bicuspid aortic valve disease
support_spans: Revealed mild aortic regurgitation of the bicuspid aortic valve
candidates.why: The presence of a bicuspid aortic valve is a specific finding that supports this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Aortic aneurysm
support_spans: Revealed ascending aortic aneurysm with diameters of ascending aorta and sinus of Valsalva at 49mm and 40mm respectively
candidates.why: The imaging studies showing an ascending aortic aneurysm support this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Acute coronary syndrome due to thrombotic occlusion
support_spans: Organized thrombus measuring 1 × 0.8 cm found at the left coronary cusp of the aortic valve, covering most of the left coronary artery's ostium
candidates.why: The intraoperative finding of an organized thrombus covering the left coronary artery's ostium supports this diagnosis.

key_evidence_spans: Revealed ascending aortic aneurysm with diameters of ascending aorta and sinus of Valsalva at 49mm and 40mm respectively
Revealed mild aortic regurgitation of the bicuspid aortic valve
Organized thrombus measuring 1 × 0.8 cm found at the left coronary cusp of the aortic valve, covering most of the left coronary artery's ostium

candidates.name: Marfan syndrome
support_spans: ascending aortic aneurysm with diameters of ascending aorta and sinus of Valsalva at 49mm and 40mm respectively
contradict_spans: No specific physical examination findings were reported in the case
candidates.why: The presence of an ascending aortic aneurysm and a bicuspid aortic valve could be indicative of Marfan syndrome, which is a genetic disorder that affects the body's connective tissue.
candidates.protected_reason: This diagnosis may deserve minority protection because Marfan syndrome is a rare genetic disorder that can be easily missed if not considered in the differential diagnosis.

candidates.name: Ehlers-Danlos syndrome
support_spans: ascending aortic aneurysm with diameters of ascending aorta and sinus of Valsalva at 49mm and 40mm respectively
contradict_spans: No specific physical examination findings were reported in the case
candidates.why: The presence of an ascending aortic aneurysm could be indicative of Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, which is a group of genetic disorders that affect the body's connective tissue.
candidates.protected_reason: This diagnosis may deserve minority protection because Ehlers-Danlos syndrome is a rare genetic disorder that can be easily missed if not considered in the differential diagnosis.

candidates.name: Takayasu arteritis
support_spans: slow blood perfusion in the left coronary artery, without evidence of significant atherosclerosis
contradict_spans: No abnormalities on Transcranial Doppler (TCD) and Ambulatory electrocardiography (Holter) monitoring
candidates.why: The presence of slow blood perfusion in the left coronary artery without evidence of significant atherosclerosis could be indicative of Takayasu arteritis, which is a rare form of large vessel vasculitis.
candidates.protected_reason: This diagnosis may deserve minority protection because Takayasu arteritis is a rare and easily missed condition that can have serious consequences if left untreated.
